entry.title: Genre bookstores are having a moment — especially in Chicago
entry.summary: From romance to horror, genre readers are done settling for just a few shelves. Now they are coming for the entire store.

entry.title: Walmart debuts longer Black Friday, Cyber Monday sales events
entry.summary: The mass retailer's deal events will total 14 days this season, compared to 10 in 2025.

entry.title: Target spruces up SoHo store, fan shops ahead of the holidays
entry.summary: In both cases, a localized presentation is key to what the retailer calls its “merchandising authority.”

entry.title: CVS wants to sell more Pokémon, collectibles
entry.summary: The pharmacy retailer is expanding its assortment of toys and collectibles as adults fuel growth in those segments.

entry.title: Banana Republic debuts TikTok content series in bid for younger shoppers
entry.summary: The effort spotlights various styles and arrives as parent Gap Inc. continues to emphasize entertainment marketing.

entry.title: Dollar General sued by FTC over ‘deceptive pricing practices’
entry.summary: The agency, along with 20 states, allege that customers are charged more at the register than prices displayed on tags and in ads.

entry.title: 5 of the biggest retail horror stories of 2026
entry.summary: From Nike’s turnaround setbacks to Chip Wilson’s battle with Lululemon, the spookiest sights weren’t found on retailers’ shelves this year.

entry.title: Walmart’s chief marketer breaks down retailer’s Muppet-fueled holiday campaign
entry.summary: For a unified push during the holidays, the retailer is recreating the world of “The Muppet Christmas Carol” and extending its “Who Knew?” brand platform.

entry.title: These 3 department stores need a good holiday
entry.summary: Kohl’s, J.C. Penney and — once again— Saks Fifth Avenue have a lot riding on this year’s shopping season.

entry.title: Target overhauls Threshold home goods brand
entry.summary: The $3 billion private label has improved quality, merchandising and, in some cases, prices, and added more than 800 items to the assortment.
